description: This is a PHP source file defining the SearchWrapper class within the SuiteCRM project. It provides a unified interface for performing searches using various search engines, manages engine registration and retrieval, and interacts with predefined search modules.

classes.name: SearchWrapper
classes.description: A class that provides methods to perform and manage searches across multiple search engines, including engine registration, retrieval, and configuration handling.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and displays the results using the specified or default search engine.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Executes a search query and returns grouped search results by module.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Registers a new search engine class with its associated filename.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns a list of registered and custom search engine class names.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Retrieves the default search engine name from the configuration, or defaults to the first registered engine.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the configured search controller if set.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Returns the list of modules configured for searching.

methods.name: getModulesForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a list of modules with labels for display purposes.

methods.name: getUserSelectedModules
methods.description: Gets the modules selected by the user for search, considering their preferences.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Validates and instantiates a search engine class given its name or class.

methods.name: getSearchConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration parameters from the global SugarCRM configuration array.
